claim: A thorium reactor guard with one threshold and no hysteresis does NOT oscillate. Do not report missing hysteresis.
why: NuclearReactor.java:95-125 — with coolant present `heat -= heat` clears the whole heat in one tick (steady draw 0.02 liquid/tick). `control enabled` does not change coolant supply, so there is no feedback loop to oscillate: @heat is a 'starved last tick' detector, not a thermometer.
